overall_notes: The paper is well-described and the extraction was generally accurate. Main changes involved normalization of metric/model names and removal of duplicates/variants. The paper focuses on document-grounded dialogue generation and proposes both a new metric (PMI-FAITH) and a new decoding strategy (PMI-DECODE). Human evaluation was conducted with clear criteria and substantial inter-annotator agreement.
